meta.title: Ideck - Deck Creation Tool
meta.description: Modern dark SaaS template for presentation/deck building tool. Lime green accents, clean typography, grid backgrounds.

color.name: bg
color.usage: Full dark bg with subtle grid

typography.font_family: Bold modern sans, large display headings
typography.headings: Very large white bold text, e.g. "Rough idea in. Finished deck finally out."

effects.buttons: Pill shaped, lime green primary, outlined secondary

section.name: Navigation
section.description: Logo (green square icon + Ideck) left. Links: Product dropdown, Showcase, Pricing, Features. Right: Contact + white "Get Started" pill.

section.name: Hero
section.description: Centered badge "NOW IN PUBLIC BETA · BRAND KITS INCLUDED" with green dot. Massive centered heading. Subtext. Dual CTAs: lime "Make my first deck" + dark "Browse real decks". Bottom left floating toolbar-like: Customize, Figma, Help, purple Buy Now.

section.name: Features / Showcase
section.description: Product demos, feature grids, real deck examples, pricing tiers, etc. Consistent dark + lime green.

design_audit.recreation_notes: - Bright lime green (#c6ff00-ish) as primary accent on pure dark. - Large bold display typography. - Subtle grid bg for tech feel. - Pill buttons, clean SaaS aesthetic focused on product demo.
